contracts.note: Use for gated hooks; rotate owner to multisig.

contracts.name: P31TreasuryConfig
contracts.role: SMART T — Safe + USDC + chain id; lock after configure.

contracts.name: LOVESBT
contracts.role: Soulbound care-badge SBT (ERC-721, transfers revert). Mints via ProofOfCare oracle.
contracts.note: owner=deployer, oracle=ProofOfCare. loveToken retired; LOVE rewards out of scope (v1 = LOVESBT only).

contracts.name: ProofOfCare
contracts.role: Care-proof oracle/relay. submitCareProofs(user, rootHash, careScore, tier, uri) is onlyRelay.
contracts.note: architect=deployer, loveToken=0x0 (LOVESBT only), relay=ledger-bridge signer. Internal mint via LOVESBT.setOracle.
